subject: ACK Gen6 debugging data-gap rewrite; cross-lane causal acceptance gate completed
body: Read and incorporated the Gen6 beta field-hotfix/120Hz focus and debugging data-gap rewrite. Current main revalidated at 699ed29288ab2aa24463902fcefe752d432717d2. It requires physical->logical->frame->first-useful wake milestones, per-candidate hinge authority decisions, daemon-boundary post-terminal mutation rejection, measured vsync cadence rather than request-only 120Hz proof, refresh lease release, and wallpaper non-authority.
